intent: The dry bed of a dead inland sea: a broad pale grey salt flat strewn with bleached bones and dark basalt islands, a colossal ribcage and a lone watchtower as landmarks, with a slow ochre-tinged dust devil turning over it; from the high camera it reads as an open pale basin whose dark rock and warm bone stand against the salt.
requests: A Salt (or cracked mud plate) Terrain material for the flats: Sand carries the pale crust, but the plates only read on the road.
A funnel or twister set-piece motion (or a stream look that tapers along its path), so a dust devil narrows toward the top instead of reading as a rising plume.
A bone-spire sculpt kind (standing ribs or vertebrae) for the kings' stone rings; waystones in bone colours are doing that work.
